BiblicalUsage: Belshazzar means "Bel protect the king." He was king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall. It turns up in Daniel 5:1, Daniel 5:2 and Daniel 5:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Belshazzar is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
